name: web-blocker
description: The simplest Web Blocker & Timer. Customizable block modes, daily time limits, schedules, and block screens.

scripts.zip:chrome: cp manifest.chrome.json manifest.json && zip -r web-blocker-chrome.zip manifest.json background.js assets/ src/ -x "assets/screenshots*"
scripts.zip:firefox: cp manifest.firefox.json manifest.json && zip -r web-blocker-firefox.zip manifest.json background.js assets/ src/ -x "assets/screenshots*" && cp manifest.chrome.json manifest.json
scripts.zip: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
